title: Avocado Cream vs Aloe Vera Gel: Which Suits Your Skin?
ex: Aloe gel is light and cooling; avocado cream is richer and holds moisture in. How to choose, and how to use both together.
rt: Avocado Cream vs Aloe Vera Gel: Which to Choose | Mirc Glow
rd: Avocado cream vs aloe vera gel: compare texture, skin types and best time to use each, plus how to layer both together in a simple Indian skincare routine.
keyword: avocado cream vs aloe vera gel
quick: Aloe vera gel is light and cooling, best for oily skin, summer days and after sun. Avocado cream is richer and helps hold moisture in, better for dry, normal and most skin at night. You can layer both: gel first, then cream.
facts: Aloe gel is mostly water in a light gel
A cream adds water plus oils to hold it in
Layer thinnest first: gel, then cream
Aloe gel is not a sunscreen
